page.title: Text Extraction
page.intro: A playground for the API: every form here sends one request to {path} with your key.
login.title: Log in
login.intro: Log in with an API key of this service. The key stays in this tab and is sent as a header with each request.
switch.label: Language
switch.hint: Switching the language reloads the page. You stay logged in; an open job view closes, but its jobs keep running.
hint.access.respect: The checks of robots.txt and the TDM opt-out apply as this service is set up.
hint.access.maximum: For sites that allowed extraction by contract: sends {value}, so the checks are off, and a page that refuses (HTTP 403, 429 or 503) or gives too little text falls back to the unblock browser. The outbound limits and a host's pause still apply.
hint.access.maximum_site: For sites that allowed extraction by contract: sends {value}, so the checks are off. A site crawl reads its pages over HTTP only and never uses the browser.
hint.access.off: Not available: maximum extraction needs {browser} and {unblock} switched on in this deployment.
mode.label: Browser fallback
mode.no_browser: This deployment has no browser ({setting} is off), so "always" is not available.
mode.fast_with_maximum: With maximum extraction, "never" stays with HTTP: the page never reaches the browser.
shell.banner: This service runs without authentication: anyone who can reach it can use the API and this UI.
form.wait: Wait seconds before it becomes a job
form.options_hint: Any further field of the REST body, merged under the fields above; a field left at its default yields to the same key here.
form.batch_hint: More URLs than one batch takes ({setting}) are sent as several batches.
form.batch_file: CSV or JSON file of URLs
form.batch_file_hint: A CSV with a {column} column (or the URLs in its first column), delimited by commas, semicolons or tabs; or a JSON array of URLs or of objects with {column}. The service checks it and shows a preview first.
form.url_or_text: A URL or a text, not both.
form.scope_path: path: only below the start URL's directory
form.info_intro: The service's name and version, and who this key is.
progress.keep_running: The jobs below were started and keep running.
progress.site_total: The total grows while it crawls.
progress.cancel_confirm: Cancel this job and delete it with its results?
progress.cancelled: Job {id} ({kind}) was cancelled and deleted with its results.
result.previews_hint: The service fetches the images with its own checks; the image hosts do not see you.
tree.label: Site tree
tree.title: Site tree of job {id}
tree.snapshot: A snapshot: the job is still running.
